items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: He wrote it with Joe Huertas.

ctx.x: Did you hear him? Erwin Leclerc?

I can't say that I ever remember hearing Erwin play, but I can tell you a funny story about Erwin. Erwin wrote quite a bit of nice tunes. I knew one tune called It's Too Late to Be Sorry. He wrote it with Joe Huertas. I don't think anybody ever played it. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc came in there and he knew me and I knew him, but he didn't know that I knew this tune and I started playing it for him. And you should have seen the expression on his face.
